description: Synthetic muscle woven along the arms, torqued past anything meat can manage. It shows: the unwired step back when you flex.

failure_messages.burnout: Something tears deep in the bundle and your grip goes to nothing.
failure_messages.dead: The myomer stops answering. Your arm is just an arm again, and a tired one.
failure_messages.fault: The actuator locks halfway through the movement. Your arm stops where it is and will not be argued with.
failure_messages.strain: The bundles along your arms are running hot enough to feel through the skin, and the tremor in your hands is not yours.

name: Myomer Bundles
